script.source: if (ctx.event != null && ctx.event.ingested != null && ctx['@timestamp'] != null) { try { def ingested = java.time.Instant.parse(ctx.event.ingested.toString()).toEpochMilli(); def eventTime = java.time.Instant.parse(ctx['@timestamp'].toString()).toEpochMilli(); ctx.event.ingest_lag_ms = ingested - eventTime; } catch (Exception e) { } }

def agents = ctx.sentinel.agents_raw; def names = new ArrayList(); def places = new ArrayList(); int maxDuration = 0; for (def agent : agents) { if (agent.agentName != null) { names.add(agent.agentName); } if (agent.directoryEntry != null) { def key = agent.directoryEntry; int slash = key.lastIndexOf('/'); places.add(slash >= 0 ? key.substring(slash + 1) : key); } if (agent.timeInMinutes != null) { int duration = ((Number) agent.timeInMinutes).intValue(); if (duration > maxDuration) { maxDuration = duration; } } } ctx.sentinel.agent = ['count': agents.size(), 'duration_minutes': maxDuration, 'names': names]; if (!names.isEmpty()) { ctx.sentinel.agent.name = names.get(0); } if (ctx.sentinel.place == null) { ctx.sentinel.place = [:]; } ctx.sentinel.place.names = places; if (!places.isEmpty() && ctx.sentinel.place.name == null) { ctx.sentinel.place.name = places.get(0); }

set.if: ctx.message != null && ctx.message.startsWith('Sentinel detected locked agents')

ctx.message != null && (ctx.message.contains('initiating graceful shutdown') || ctx.message.contains('initiating forceful shutdown') || ctx.message.contains('exiting now'))

script.source: def rules = ctx.sentinel.rules_raw; def names = new ArrayList(); def places = new ArrayList(); for (def rule : rules) { if (rule.name != null) { names.add(rule.name); } if (rule.place != null) { places.add(rule.place); } } ctx.sentinel.rule = ['count': rules.size(), 'names': names, 'places': places]; if (!names.isEmpty()) { ctx.sentinel.rule.name = names.get(0); }

ctx.sentinel != null && ctx.sentinel.place != null && ctx.sentinel.place.names == null && ctx.sentinel.place.name != null

set.if: ctx.message != null && (ctx.message == 'Sentinel stopped' || ctx.message == 'Sentinel is disabled' || ctx.message.startsWith('Sentinel initialized'))

script.source: if (ctx.sentinel == null) { ctx.sentinel = [:]; } if (ctx.sentinel.error == null) { ctx.sentinel.error = [:]; } if (ctx.sentinel.error.signature == null) { String msg = ctx.message.toString(); if (msg.length() > 240) { msg = msg.substring(0, 240); } ctx.sentinel.error.signature = msg; }
